subject: Your CanvasTrail weekend bag
preview_text: Continue with the EUR 80 bag whenever you’re ready.
headline: Return to your weekend bag when you’re ready
body:
A quick note about the CanvasTrail weekend bag you added to your basket. If you would like to continue deciding, the basket is the place to pick up again.

The bag costs EUR 80. Shipping charges are shown at checkout, so you can see them as you move through the purchase path.

You can return when you’re ready, look over what is in your basket, and decide whether you want to complete the purchase. This reminder is simply a way back to the choice you had already started considering, in your own time.
